name: infernal_worker
description: an Infernal Worker, a hunched reddish-brown demon labourer: two curved dark horns, big pointed ears, glowing yellow eyes, a torn red shirt under a dark grey apron with metal rivets, bare muscular brown arms, clawed bare brown feet, a red spade-tipped devil's tail curling out on the screen-left side, and a long wooden hoe with a dark steel blade, gripped by the top end of its shaft in his RIGHT hand
hands: the hoe's shaft end stays in his right hand on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the shaft lower down, near the blade, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the shaft, the hoe is lifted high beside the horned head with its shaft level and its dark steel blade out to the right
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hoe hand behind the head and the hoe hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, its steel blade low behind him, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the hoe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the hoe is level, its steel blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: hoe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the hoe's steel blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the hoe carries on down until its steel blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red tail and the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the hoe comes back toward its resting angle with the blade low at the lower-right, the left hand reaching for the shaft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the horned head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (hoe arm thrown up and out to the left with the hoe swinging across level, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the hoe held across the body, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, hoe arm flung up, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the horned head droops, the hoe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the hoe's steel blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the hoe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, horns on the ground; the hoe lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red tail limp beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the grey apron settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, yellow eyes dark, the hoe on the ground beside him
